newsitem.title: UK: Clarke sees continued rapid UK growth.
newsitem.headline: Clarke sees continued rapid UK growth.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke on Wednesday predicted that the British economy would continue to grow rapidly, with growth exceeding three percent next year.
In a parliamentary debate, Clarke said: "The economy is extremely healthy. It is growing as I predicted it would and the growth is strengthening as the year goes on."
"The economy is clearly set to grow by over three percent next year, I think everyone will agree, and I believe it will go on growing rapidly," he added.

Clarke said his decision to raise interest rates by a quarter point earlier on Wednesday was based on "judgments about how we keep it going 18 months to two years ahead when we will still have a Conservative government in power". -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
